name: frontend-skill-builder
description: Authors structured SKILL.md files for frontend technologies, then checks the result against a fixed section contract.

interface.longDescription: Creates and revises SKILL.md files for frontend work such as React components, Next.js App Router data fetching, TypeScript data modelling, and Tailwind layout. Each skill is planned against a fixed contract of fifteen sections, drafted section by section, and checked with a bundled validator that reports missing required sections, unresolved template placeholders, and frontmatter problems. Revising an existing skill preserves the sections you did not ask to change, so an edit stays scoped to the part you named. The validator runs as a script from the plugin bundle, so the checks do not depend on a connected tool server.
defaultPrompt: Create a beginner skill for building accessible React components.
Improve my existing Next.js App Router SKILL.md without rewriting unrelated sections.
Validate this SKILL.md and list the required sections that are missing.
